project_type: Full-stack TypeScript monorepo: AWS CDK infra + Lambda backends + React frontend for slide/video generation
build_system: pnpm workspace monorepo. Packages: packages/*, infra, lambdas/*, frontend, config. Build order matters: shared-types -> core -> renderer-port -> renderer-ffmpeg -> lambdas -> infra -> frontend
test_framework: vitest throughout all packages. CDK assertions for infra tests. jsdom for frontend tests.
verification_instructions: 1. pnpm install 2. pnpm build (all packages compile) 3. pnpm test (all tests pass) 4. For infra: cdk synth must succeed via the test suite (Template.fromStack)
setup_instructions: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh to get Node 22 + pnpm in PATH. pnpm install to install deps.
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network - npm registry accessible. No Docker daemon available - Dockerfiles must be validated structurally (file exists, correct FROM/COPY). No FFmpeg/FFprobe available. No AWS services for integration testing. Validate via unit tests with mocks.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code patterns: ESM (type:module in lambdas), CJS for packages. vitest for all testing. CDK constructs in infra/lib/. Lambda handlers in lambdas/<name>/src/index.ts. TypeScript strict mode. No em dashes in code.
key_patterns: Single Lambda for API with path-based routing. CDK constructs per service (storage, auth, api, etc). renderer-port defines abstract interface, renderer-ffmpeg implements. shared-types is the types package all others depend on. core has business logic (s3-keys, duration, captions). config has environment params.
directory_structure: Root: monorepo config (package.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml, tsconfig.json). packages/shared-types: type defs. packages/core: business logic. packages/renderer-port: abstract video renderer. packages/renderer-ffmpeg: FFmpeg impl. lambdas/api: API handler. lambdas/polly-worker: TTS. lambdas/marp-render: slide rendering. lambdas/render-worker: video rendering. lambdas/slide-generator: Bedrock outline. infra/: CDK stack + constructs. frontend/: React SPA. config/: env params. mockup/: HTML mockups (reference only).
